title: Corvus language pack
description: Everything the app knows about one target language. The code reads this file instead of assuming a language; the file is named after the code, e.g. la.json.

code.description: BCP-47 code; matches the 'language' field of card files and this file's name.

grids.description: Named parse grids, keyed by id. A cell id is '<row id>.<col id>', so a grid's cells are every row crossed with every column.

defaultGrid.description: The grid used by parse cards that don't name one.

paradigms.description: Inflection patterns that ending cards point to, keyed by id. Used to report which cells of a pattern have been taught.

inputKeys.description: Characters for the on-screen key bar above typed answers, in display order.

lang.description: BCP-47 code of the default text-to-speech voice. It can differ from the target language when no voice for it exists.

rules.description: Respelling applied to text before it is spoken, never to what is displayed. The text is NFD-normalized, each rule is applied in order as a global, case-insensitive regular expression, and the result is NFC-normalized. Patterns use only syntax that JavaScript and Python read the same way, and replacements are literal text (no group references).

tests.description: Expected output of the rules for sample inputs (compared lowercased). The test suite runs every pack's vectors.

ignoreWords.description: Words in the learner's own language that may be added or left out of a typed meaning without changing it (articles, the 'to' of an infinitive). Compared lowercased, as whole words.

spellingVariants.description: Spellings that printed texts use and the cards avoid. check-cards warns when card text in the target language contains a variant. Answer checking does not use these; the variants are taught in notes, for reading.

letters.description: Characters, compared after NFD normalization, so a combining mark can be listed on its own.

id.description: Lowercase letters and digits; may be dot-joined (e.g. 'sg.m') when one axis combines two features.

standard.description: The spelling the cards use; empty when the variant is a mark the cards leave out.
